posts.title: New Incentives for Renewable Energy Producers
posts.excerpt: Recent amendments revise feed-in tariffs and grid-connection rules. We outline what developers need to know.
body: Amendments adopted this year revise the tariff mechanism for renewable generators and clarify the process for connecting to the national grid.
Developers with projects in the pipeline should review their power purchase arrangements and permitting timelines against the new rules.
This note is a general overview and not legal advice; please contact us to discuss how the changes affect your project.

posts.title: Privatisation of State-Owned Enterprises: A Practical Guide
posts.excerpt: The government has announced a new round of privatisations. Here is how the process works and where investors can participate.
body: A new privatisation programme lists several state-owned enterprises for full or partial sale.
We summarise the tender procedure, eligibility criteria for foreign bidders and key due-diligence considerations.
Investors should engage early, as bidding windows are typically short.

posts.title: Draft Minerals Law: Key Proposals
posts.excerpt: A draft revision of the minerals law proposes changes to licensing, state participation and stability agreements.
body: The draft would reshape the licensing regime and the framework for state equity participation in strategic deposits.
Stakeholders have been invited to comment during the consultation period.
We will continue to monitor the draft as it moves through parliament.

posts.title: Taxation on Transfers of Mineral Licences
posts.excerpt: Clarification from the tax authority on how indirect transfers of licence-holding entities are taxed.
body: The tax authority has issued guidance on the treatment of indirect transfers of entities holding mineral licences.
The guidance affects offshore holding structures and may trigger local tax filing obligations.
Parties to pending transactions should reassess their structuring and tax indemnities.

posts.title: Land-Use Fee Changes for Commercial Property
posts.excerpt: Updated land-use fee rates take effect this year. We explain the impact on commercial landholders.
body: New rates for land-use fees apply to commercial and industrial land in major cities.
Businesses should budget for the increase and check that their land-use certificates are up to date.

posts.title: Firm Joins International Legal Alliance
posts.excerpt: We are pleased to announce our membership of an international network of independent business law firms.
body: Membership gives our clients access to trusted counsel in more than 40 jurisdictions.
It also strengthens our ability to support inbound investors from Europe, Asia and North America.
